summary: The local SQLite store is a queried-directly interface, so its schema must be discoverable from the CLI: `db schema` prints the store path, tables, and columns, and the docs name the two columns sessions guess wrong (meetings.row_source, folders.title). The incremental-sync fallback warning fires only when --since was passed explicitly, because the automatic last-synced checkpoint reaches the non-incremental resources on every routine run and warning on a default the user never chose is noise.
reason: Transcript mining showed agent sessions querying data.db with sqlite3 for questions the commands don't cover, guessing column names from convention and failing (source for row_source, name for folders' title), then probing PRAGMA table_info to recover. Without a published contract every new session repeats that loop. The sync warning half: folders and notes declare no temporal filter, so every routine incremental sync emitted the same resource_not_incremental warning pair without the user asking for --since at all.
validated_outcome: db schema --json lists meetings.row_source and folders.title against a fresh temp store and exits not-found (not generic 1) with a run-sync hint when the store is absent; sync --agent with no --since emits no resource_not_incremental events while --since still does.
